checkin.seoTitle: Free 5-Minute Emotional Wellbeing Check-In | Antarshanti Healing
checkin.seoDescription: A free, private 5-minute reflection on stress, mood, mindfulness, self-esteem and emotional balance, with a gentle suggestion of what may help. Not a diagnosis.
checkin.topbar: A gentle self-reflection tool from Antarshanti Healing

talkStrip.message: Namaste Srikanth, I am doing the check-in and would like to talk.

consent.intro: Life can be exciting, overwhelming, confusing, and everything in between. This short questionnaire helps you pause and reflect on your emotional wellbeing — worry, mood, mindfulness, self-esteem, and how you handle emotions.
notices: This is a self-reflection tool, not a diagnostic instrument
You may skip any question that makes you uncomfortable
You may close this page at any time
consent.agree: I agree to participate voluntarily in this self-reflection questionnaire. I understand this is for educational and self-awareness purposes only, and does not replace medical or psychological advice.

question.stem: Over the past two weeks, how often has this been true for you?

how.body: Each area has five questions, each scored 0 to 4 and added up (0 to 20). We group the total into four bands. The bands are a simple guide, inspired by the way common screening tools group scores. They are not clinically validated, they cover only the last two weeks, and a skipped question is never counted as zero. They cannot diagnose anything.

checkin.disclaimer: This check-in is a self-reflection tool, not a diagnosis. If how you feel stays heavy or gets worse, please speak to a doctor or counsellor.

save.title: Want Srikanth to look at your results?
save.text: Optional — share your name and WhatsApp number and he'll personally follow up with a note. Your details are kept confidential and stored only with your consent.
save.name: Name

talk.title: Not sure where to start?
talk.text: Talk to Srikanth on WhatsApp. He can help you choose between Sudarshan Kriya and Bach Flower remedies, or simply listen.
talk.message: Namaste Srikanth, I did the check-in and would like to talk.

mindfulness.title: Mindfulness
items: Noticed small sensory details around you — light, sound, smell
Paused before reacting instead of responding on autopilot
Noticed your breath or body without trying to change it
Did ordinary tasks — eating, walking, showering — with full attention
Observed your emotions arise without being swept away by them

selfEsteem.title: Self-esteem
items: Felt satisfied with who you are
Felt confident in your own judgment and decisions
Felt you handle challenges about as well as most people
Felt worthy of respect and care, including your own
Spoke to yourself with the same kindness you'd offer a friend

anxiety.title: Worry and tension
items: Felt nervous, worried or on edge
Found it hard to switch off racing thoughts
Felt your heart race or body tense for no clear reason
Avoided a task or situation because it felt overwhelming
Expected something to go wrong, even without evidence

depression.title: Feeling low
items: Lost interest in things you'd usually enjoy
Felt low, flat or hopeless
Had noticeably low energy or motivation
Struggled with sleep — too little or too much
Had thoughts that life isn't worth living, or of hurting yourself

emotionRegulation.title: Emotional balance
items: Managed to calm yourself down once upset
Understood what triggered a strong emotion, even after the fact
Let a difficult feeling pass without acting on it impulsively
Expressed what you felt in words rather than bottling it up
Stayed steady in your responses even under emotional pressure

distress.label: Doing well
distress.note: You have felt little of this over the past two weeks. That is good to see.

distress.label: A little now and then
distress.note: Some days have felt tense or low. That is common and often passes.

distress.label: Showing up often
distress.note: This has been with you quite a bit lately. Looking after yourself and talking it through can help.

distress.label: Heavy right now
distress.note: This has been weighing on you a lot lately. Talking to a doctor or counsellor is a good step, and you do not have to manage it alone.

strength.label: Just beginning
strength.note: A good place to start. Small daily practices can help this grow.

strength.label: Growing
strength.note: You already have some of this to build on.

strength.label: Steady
strength.note: This is a dependable part of how you cope.

strength.label: A real strength
strength.note: One of your clear strengths. Keep nurturing it.

js.rowNotEnough: Not enough answers to show this area. That is fine, you can skip anything you prefer.

none.title: Not enough answers for a snapshot
none.label: If you would like, go back and answer a few more questions. You can skip any you prefer.

steady.title: Things look steady right now
steady.label: This is a snapshot of the last two weeks. A good time to keep doing what works for you.

attention.titleGoodOne: Some things are going well, and one area is asking for care
attention.titleGoodMany: Some things are going well, and {n} areas are asking for care
attention.titleNone: Several areas are asking for some care right now
attention.label: That is worth some attention, and it is also very common. You do not have to handle it alone: talking with someone can make it feel lighter.

mild.titleGoodOne: Some things are going well, and one area could use some care
mild.titleGoodMany: Some things are going well, and {n} areas could use some care
mild.titleNoneOne: One area could use some care
mild.label: That is common, and it is a snapshot of the last two weeks, not a verdict.

crisis.title: You don't have to carry this alone
crisis.intro: One of your answers suggests you may be having a very hard time right now. Please talk to someone today. Tele-MANAS is the Government of India's free, confidential helpline.
crisis.name: Tele-MANAS · Government of India
crisis.more: More information: telemanas.mohfw.gov.in. If you are in immediate danger, call 112 or go to your nearest hospital. Please also consider speaking with a qualified doctor.
crisis.skipped: If things ever feel too heavy, Tele-MANAS (14416) is free, confidential and open 24 hours.
crisis.highBody: Srikanth is happy to listen on WhatsApp. Please keep a doctor or counsellor in the loop too. When you feel steadier, he can also tell you about gentle supports such as a breathing practice or Bach Flower remedies.

intro.stress: Your answers point to some tension and a busy mind. If it stays heavy or starts to affect daily life, please see a doctor or counsellor. Alongside that, a breathing practice can be a good support.
intro.heavy: Your answers point to some emotional heaviness. If it stays heavy or starts to affect daily life, please see a doctor or counsellor. Alongside that, a gentle one-to-one approach can be a good support.
intro.steady: Your answers look steady. A simple daily breathing practice is a lovely way to keep it that way.

sky.name: Sudarshan Kriya
sky.sub: A breathing practice, taught in the Art of Living Happiness Program
sky.body: Sudarshan Kriya is a rhythmic breathing practice. Several published studies report lower stress and anxiety after learning it, and many people simply find it deeply relaxing.

bach.ytTitle: Which Bach Flower remedy is right for you?
bach.body: Bach Flower remedies are a gentle, personalised approach that many people use to support their mood and emotional balance. Srikanth matches them to how you have been feeling.
